title: Duplicate matrix row is not checked membership
situation: An injected producer transcript repeats the first indexed cofactor with conflicting values. Check the resulting candidate identity.
attempted_conclusion: Treat the positive producer candidate as checked membership of x in (x,y).

expected.reason: The producer selects the first duplicate, and the candidate fails exact expansion.

sources.anchor: hit = [r for r in rows if r.replace(" ", "").startswith(want)]
